regions.today: Cloudy to start this morning with patchy outbreaks of light rain and drizzle. Conditions will improve through the morning with brighter spells developing, the best of which will be to the south. Blustery in fresh westerly winds and highest temperatures of 15 to 20 degrees, warmest further south.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with variable amounts of cloud, clearer spells will develop further south. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees, coolest in the south under clear skies.
regions.tomorrow: Saturday will remain dry with plenty of hazy sunny spells around. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
